title: Projektetage Column Text Morph
description: Fix projektetage tiles-to-text transition: all column tiles should morph into one shared label per column (not first tile to text then text to stack). Use column ghost bridge slide and columnMorphId labels.
summary: Fixed forward column→label auto-animate: reveal.js animates the `to` element, but empty opacity-0 tile sinks were invisible forward (tiles faded as unmatched). Labels now render real figure tiles at the stack via morphSourceTiles (presentation-column-morph-label-tile, visible only while data-auto-animate=running). Headings stay fixed without data-id. Backward morph unchanged.
